problems: Ecommerce stores need email, SMS and web-push campaigns tied to customer behavior instead of sending the same message to every subscriber.
Merchants need repeatable welcome, abandoned-cart and post-purchase automations so routine lifecycle follow-up does not depend on manual sends.
Growing stores need forms, segmentation, campaign reporting and store integrations in one workflow so list growth, targeting and performance review stay connected.

monetization.title: Set up ecommerce lifecycle automations
monetization.output: Configured welcome, abandoned-cart and post-purchase workflows using client-approved copy, timing and store events, plus a QA checklist

monetization.title: Deliver campaign and segmentation setup
monetization.output: Client-ready audience segments, signup forms and an email campaign template with consent, brand and deliverability checks documented

monetization.title: Offer recurring ecommerce messaging optimization
monetization.output: Monthly review of observed campaign, automation and list metrics with prioritized tests and implementation notes, without revenue guarantees
